verdict.rationale: Codegen can create tasks in Jira/Linear/Clickup/Monday and present a structured implementation plan for a given prompt, which covers the 'structured task + scope' half of the story, but there is no evidence of ingesting or triaging raw user-feedback submissions specifically as a PM input source. missing for 10: evidence of feedback-intake mechanism, PM-specific triage workflow, explicit 'proposed scope' output tied to feedback items.
